title: Better Looking Tools
description: Fancy But Also Looking Tools Resource Pack In Minecraft
body:
I present you "Colorful Tools pack"
this pack made to change all tools textures.
this pack changes normal tools into colorful tools
that looks beautiful or visually stunning in the games.
this pack works without any mods or support packs.
simply applying the pack change the tools textures.

this pack work in both single and multiplayer worlds.

This changes the texture of following tools:-

**1. Sword**

1) Wooden Sword
2) Stone Sword
3) Copper Sword
4) Iron Sword
5) Golden Sword
6) Diamond Sword
7) Netherite Sword

**2. Pickaxe**

1) Wooden Pickaxe
2) Stone Pickaxe
3) Copper Pickaxe
4) Iron Pickaxe
5) Golden Pickaxe
6) Diamond Pickaxe
7) Netherite Pickaxe

**3. Axe**

1) Wooden Axe
2) Stone Axe
3) Copper Axe
4) Iron Axe
5) Golden Axe
6) Diamond Axe
7) Netherite Axe

**4. Shovel**
1) Wooden Shovel

7) Netherite Shovel

**5. Hoe**

**6. Spear**

1) Wooden Spear

3) Copper Spear

5) Golden Spear
6) Diamond Spear
7) Netherite Spear

**7. Arrow**

1) Arrow
2) Spectral Arrow
3) Tipped Arrow

**8. Bow & Crossbow**

1) Bow
2) Crossbow

**9. Trident**

1) Trident

**10. Shear**

1) Shear

pack contains separate versions. 

this pack work in every version
from 1.16 to latest.

thank you for downloading.
enjoy the "Colorful Tools Pack".
